legacy.title: Beta.8 developer credential arrival evidence (#211)
legacy.description: Arrival fixtures for four developer credential families no registry detector targets: GitHub fine-grained PATs (github_pat_), Slack app-level tokens (xapp-), Stripe webhook signing secrets (whsec_, context-gated) and Notion integration tokens (ntn_). Prefixes are provider-documented; body grammars are community/tool evidence kept provisional. Measures and records; asserts no product support.
